<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in North-West Pakistan]]
**Four are killed and over 20 injured in a bomb blast near a [[Law enforcement in Pakistan|police]] station in [[Quetta]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/killed-blast-police-station-quetta-190730174225362.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 18 people, including thirteen civilians and five crew members, are killed and 12 others injured after a small military plane crashes into a residential area near the [[Pakistan]]i city of [[Rawalpindi]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49160416 (BBC)]
*Eleven deaths and multiple hospitalizations are attributed to the ongoing heat wave in [[Japan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49173879 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Abdullah of Pahang|Al-Sultan Abdullah]] is [[Coronation of Yang di-Pertuan Agong XVI|crowned]] as the 16th [[Yang di-Pertuan Agong]] of Malaysia at [[Istana Negara, Jalan Tuanku Abdul Halim|Istana Negara]], [[Kuala Lumpur]]. [https://www.bharian.com.my/berita/nasional/2019/07/590611/istiadat-pertabalan-yang-di-pertuan-agong-ke-16-bermula (Berita Harian)]
*[[Romania]]n [[Ministry of Internal Affairs (Romania)|Interior Minister]] {{ill|Nicolae Moga|ro}} resigns amid outrage over the slow response by police, state prosecutor's office and the secret service in charge of telecomunications to the [[Murder of Alexandra Măceşanu|disappearance and possible murder of a 15-year-old girl]] in the city of [[Caracal, Romania|Caracal]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/romanian-interior-minister-resigns-amid-outrage-over-teenage-girl-murder-case/30083540.html (RFE/RL)]
